verdict.rationale: Model failover is a fair question for an agent framework, but nothing in the evidence documents automatic fallback to another provider or model on errors or rate limits. Routing to 90+ providers through one interface and workflow-step retries are adjacent features, not failover, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
